items.title: 60499_Garvin Bushell oral history interview
items.q: But we had hired her to sing, but you have to have a feature attraction in a vaudeville act.

ctx.x: But we had hired her to sing, but you have to have a feature attraction in a vaudeville act. You have a center. The act was built around her, you see, and -- as a singer, and she did a little dance and she was the glamour of the act, you see. Five big rough men in tuxedos and all, but she was the glamour, nice looking girl. So you had an act like that you always -- the woman singer, you say, so and so and her jazzband. Mamie Smith and her Jazz -- Edith Wilson and her Jazz Hounds --
I see, but the band was like -- the band itself --
